Name: Dynamic Combat
Author: NoNameKz
Description:
[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ffff][size=6][u]Features:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list=1]
[*][size=3][b]Move While Attacking/Blocking/Performing Special Attacks:[/b] No more restrictions on your character's movement during combat![/size]
[*][size=3][b]Directional Attack:[/b] Slash or slam at your enemies wherever your cursor points! No need to turn your character around first for the monster to be hit—just press attack where your cursor is aimed![/size]
[*][size=3][b]Controller Support:[/b] Fully compatible with controllers! Plus, there's a user interface option to toggle Directional Attack on/off, making it perfect for controller users![/size]
[/list]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=6][u]Compatibility:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[size=3]This mod is compatible with most other mods and has been successfully used alongside with [b]popular mod[/b] such as [b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b], [b]Ridgeside Village[/b], [b]East Scarp[/b], along with popular collections like[b] Stardew Valley Very Expanded[/b], [b]Aesthetic Valley Fairycore[/b], and [b]Aesthetic Valley Witchcore[/b], totaling over [b]200+ mods[/b]!

It also works seamlessly with the [b]latest version[/b] of Stardew Valley 1.6
[/size]

[b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]My Other Mods:[/u][/size][/color][/font][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28869]Harvest With an Axe[/url]﻿:[b] [/b][/size][size=3]Chop Multiple Trees with an Axe! Have you been frustrated with the Stardew Valley mechanics that make you cut down trees one by one? This mod provides the solution! Now you can cut multiple trees at once![/size]
[*][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28950]No More Lag[/url]﻿: Eliminate lag in heavily modded Stardew Valley - Struggling with slow load times or performance dips? This mod improves gameplay by optimizing asset preloading and memory management, ensuring smoother transitions and reduced lag during play![/size]
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
Improvements: Fixed an issue where combat effects (like special moves and speed boosts) would incorrectly continue during festivals and events, and more...
Compatibility: Tested and remains compatible with most mods and version 1.6.
